{{Quote|Astral! Let's go do this.|Anakin Solo|<ref name="Star by Star">''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]''</ref>}}
'''Astral''' was an adjective used to convey approval, similar to "awesome."<ref name="Star by Star" /> It was used by people like [[Dunc T'racen]],<ref name="Hutt and Seek">{{StoryCite|story=Hutt and Seek|book=Tales from the New Republic}}</ref> [[Anakin Solo]], [[Tahiri Veila]],<ref name="Star by Star" /> [[Ben Skywalker]],<ref name="The Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref> [[Zekk]],<ref name="The Unseen Queen">''[[Dark Nest II: The Unseen Queen]]''</ref> and [[Seha Dorvald]].<ref name="Exile">''[[Legacy of the Force: Exile]]''</ref>
